abstract.p: Text preprocessing is a fundamental component of high-quality speech synthesis. This work presents a novel rule-based phonemizer combined with a sentence-level lexical stress prediction model to improve phonetic accuracy and prosody prediction in the text-to-speech pipelines. We also introduce a new benchmark dataset with annotated stress patterns designed for evaluating lexical stress prediction systems at the sentence level. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed phonemizer achieves a 1.23% word error rate on a manually constructed pronunciation dataset, while the lexical stress prediction pipeline shows results close to dictionarybased methods, outperforming existing neural network solutions.
